en.text: I love you, LORD, my strength.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华，我的力量啊，我爱你！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華，我的力量啊，我愛你！

en.text: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华是我的岩石，我的山寨，我的救主，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華是我的巖石，我的山寨，我的救主，

en.text: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.

zhSimplified.text: 我要求告当赞美的耶和华；

zhTraditional.text: 我要求告當讚美的耶和華；

en.text: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

zhSimplified.text: 曾有死亡的绳索缠绕我，

zhTraditional.text: 曾有死亡的繩索纏繞我，

en.text: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.

footnotes.text: 18:5 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 阴间的绳索缠绕我，

zhTraditional.text: 陰間的繩索纏繞我，

en.text: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.

zhSimplified.text: 我在急难中求告耶和华，

zhTraditional.text: 我在急難中求告耶和華，

en.text: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，因他发怒，地就摇撼战抖；

zhTraditional.text: 那時，因他發怒，地就搖撼戰抖；

en.text: Smoke went out of his nostrils. out of his mouth. were kindled by it.

zhSimplified.text: 从他鼻孔冒烟上腾；

zhTraditional.text: 從他鼻孔冒煙上騰；

en.text: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. was under his feet.

zhSimplified.text: 他又使天下垂，亲自降临，

zhTraditional.text: 他又使天下垂，親自降臨，

en.text: He rode on a cherub, and flew. he soared on the wings of the wind.

zhSimplified.text: 他坐着基路伯飞行；

zhTraditional.text: 他坐着基路伯飛行；

en.text: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

zhSimplified.text: 他以黑暗为藏身之处，

zhTraditional.text: 他以黑暗為藏身之處，

en.text: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, and coals of fire.

zhSimplified.text: 因他面前的光辉，

zhTraditional.text: 因他面前的光輝，

en.text: The LORD also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华也在天上打雷；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華也在天上打雷；

en.text: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.

zhSimplified.text: 他射出箭来，使仇敌四散；

zhTraditional.text: 他射出箭來，使仇敵四散；

en.text: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你的斥责一发，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你的斥責一發，

en.text: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.

zhSimplified.text: 他从高天伸手抓住我，

zhTraditional.text: 他從高天伸手抓住我，

en.text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

zhSimplified.text: 他救我脱离我的劲敌和那些恨我的人，

zhTraditional.text: 他救我脫離我的勁敵和那些恨我的人，

en.text: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.

zhSimplified.text: 我遭遇灾难的日子，他们来攻击我；

zhTraditional.text: 我遭遇災難的日子，他們來攻擊我；

en.text: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

zhSimplified.text: 他又领我到宽阔之处；

zhTraditional.text: 他又領我到寬闊之處；

en.text: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness. to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华按着我的公义报答我，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華按着我的公義報答我，

en.text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

zhSimplified.text: 因为我遵守了耶和华的道，

zhTraditional.text: 因為我遵守了耶和華的道，

en.text: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.

zhSimplified.text: 他的一切典章常在我面前；

zhTraditional.text: 他的一切典章常在我面前；

en.text: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

zhSimplified.text: 我在他面前作了完全人；

zhTraditional.text: 我在他面前作了完全人；

en.text: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，耶和华按我的公义，

zhTraditional.text: 所以，耶和華按我的公義，

en.text: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

zhSimplified.text: 慈爱的人，你以慈爱待他；

zhTraditional.text: 慈愛的人，你以慈愛待他；

en.text: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

zhSimplified.text: 清洁的人，你以清洁待他；

zhTraditional.text: 清潔的人，你以清潔待他；

en.text: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.

zhSimplified.text: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救；

zhTraditional.text: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救；

en.text: For you will light my lamp, LORD. My God will light up my darkness.

zhSimplified.text: 你必点着我的灯；

zhTraditional.text: 你必點着我的燈；

en.text: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

zhSimplified.text: 我借着你冲入敌军，

zhTraditional.text: 我藉着你衝入敵軍，

en.text: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

zhSimplified.text: 至于 神，他的道是完全的；

zhTraditional.text: 至於上帝，他的道是完全的；

en.text: For who is God, except the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God,

zhSimplified.text: 除了耶和华，谁是 神呢？

zhTraditional.text: 除了耶和華，誰是上帝呢？

en.text: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?

zhSimplified.text: 惟有那以力量束我的腰、

zhTraditional.text: 惟有那以力量束我的腰、

en.text: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.

zhSimplified.text: 他使我的脚快如母鹿的，

zhTraditional.text: 他使我的腳快如母鹿的，

en.text: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

zhSimplified.text: 他教导我的手能以争战，

zhTraditional.text: 他教導我的手能以爭戰，

en.text: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.

zhSimplified.text: 你把你的救恩给我作盾牌；

zhTraditional.text: 你把你的救恩給我作盾牌；

en.text: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.

zhSimplified.text: 你使我脚下的地步宽阔；

zhTraditional.text: 你使我腳下的地步寬闊；

en.text: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.

zhSimplified.text: 我要追赶我的仇敌，并要追上他们；

zhTraditional.text: 我要追趕我的仇敵，並要追上他們；

en.text: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.

zhSimplified.text: 我要打伤他们，使他们不能起来；

zhTraditional.text: 我要打傷他們，使他們不能起來；

en.text: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

zhSimplified.text: 因为你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能争战；

zhTraditional.text: 因為你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能爭戰；

en.text: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

zhSimplified.text: 你又使我的仇敌在我面前转背逃跑，

zhTraditional.text: 你又使我的仇敵在我面前轉背逃跑，

en.text: They cried, but there was no one to save; to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.

zhSimplified.text: 他们呼求，却无人拯救；

zhTraditional.text: 他們呼求，卻無人拯救；

en.text: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.

zhSimplified.text: 我捣碎他们，如同风前的灰尘，

zhTraditional.text: 我搗碎他們，如同風前的灰塵，

en.text: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

zhSimplified.text: 你救我脱离百姓的争竞，

zhTraditional.text: 你救我脫離百姓的爭競，

en.text: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.

zhSimplified.text: 他们一听见我的名声就必顺从我；

zhTraditional.text: 他們一聽見我的名聲就必順從我；

en.text: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.

zhSimplified.text: 外邦人要衰残，

zhTraditional.text: 外邦人要衰殘，

en.text: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock. be the God of my salvation,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华是活。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華是活。

en.text: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.

zhSimplified.text: 这位 神，就是那为我伸冤、

zhTraditional.text: 這位上帝，就是那為我伸冤、

en.text: He rescues me from my enemies. you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

zhSimplified.text: 你救我脱离仇敌，

zhTraditional.text: 你救我脫離仇敵，

en.text: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，因此我要在外邦中称谢你，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，因此我要在外邦中稱謝你，

en.text: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华赐极大的救恩给他的王， 和他的后裔，直到永远。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華賜極大的救恩給他的王， 和他的後裔，直到永遠。
